verdict.rationale: Docs show concrete spend-cap mechanics via mandate fields (declineThreshold, effectiveUntilTime) and passkey/consent-based authorization tied to each instruction, plus a documented ability to cancel a purchase intent, which together cover spend caps and some revocation. However, revocation evidence is scoped to canceling a single purchase intent rather than an explicit 'revoke agent's payment authority instantly' control, and the product page itself flags maturity caveats ('in the process of development and deployment'). Missing for 10: a documented instant full-authority revoke/kill-switch API distinct from per-purchase cancellation, and independent/hands-on confirmation of these controls working in practice.
